shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Posted 11 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting(6): Ralltiir Operations ('Ralittaar ops./....'), Ralltiir ('Ralittaar'), Prepared Defenses, Biker Scout Gear, You Cannot Hide Forever ('YCHF') and Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO'); these count toward the total.

Posted 'Ralittaar' dested the Dark system Ralltiir (Dark); 'Spaceport DB' and 'Spaceport Office' dested the generic sites Spaceport Docking Bay and Spaceport Prefect's Office; 'Swamp' dested the Dark generic site Swamp (Dark).
Posted 'Farm' is printed as written (UNKNOWN): the only Farm card is the Light Special Edition generic site, which a Dark deck cannot play, and no Dark farm site fits Ralltiir.

Posted 'Biker scout' dested Biker Scout Trooper; 'Emporer Pappy-3' dested Emperor Palpatine (x3, as posted); 'Iggy in 2000' dested IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Bossk in bus' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Tel'k advisor' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Speeder bikes' dested the Dark Speeder Bike.
The strategy says to swap a Scout Recon for Royal Escort ('You need to take a scout recon out for royal escourt'); the list is kept as published (2 Scout Recon, no Royal Escort).
Total is 70 as published (section counts 6+6+13+5+10+16+3+11), not 60.
